other_conditions: Applicant must be an individual farmer, farmer group, Farmers Producer Organization (FPO), cooperative society, or a registered institution.
Applicant must have agricultural land between 0.25 acres and 10 acres (up to 25 acres for the cluster area).
Applicant must be registered on the DBT portal.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy of ₹1,00,000 per acre for standard crops and ₹2,00,000 per acre for premium crops, along with supply of plant material.
